Additionally, the negative diluted EPS (-0.0688) and implied net loss (despite positive operating income) suggest profitability challenges and potential difficulty servicing debt, with estimated interest coverage below 1x. However, the moderate leverage (debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 1.39) and substantial retained earnings ($21,891M) provide some financial cushion. Given these factors, the issuer falls into the highly speculative category.
